miriam_cs: Quick sync — SolsticeAI asked for a preflight config change for their pilot. They need eu-west-3 enabled for latency tests + a temporary QPS bump to 150 QPS with 400 burst for 72 hours. They're also asking to add WhisperLabs' IPs to an allowlist so their proxy can call the API.

asif_eng: Got it. Do we have the IPs and exact window? Also will model fallback be OK if we hit capacity?

miriam_cs: Partner sent IPs: 34.89.12.5/32, 34.89.12.6/32. Window: start 2026-03-23 14:00 UTC for 72h. They want canary to eu-west-3 then scale if latency looks good. Fallback to redwood-small-v1 is acceptable.

ton y_infra: Can provision eu-west-3 edge and attach temporary capacity. Need a capacity ticket with rate limits. I'll need the customer org id and assigned capacity profile.

miriam_cs: org_id=solsticeai-prod, profile=pilot-burst-standalone. Adding here so you can paste into the ticket.

ellie_ops: I'll create the change request and set auto-revoke at +72h. Will also add an alert to rollback if 95th percentile latency > 400ms.

asif_eng: For the allowlist, we prefer CIDR entries alone. Also confirm we should add a route to the partner egress so traffic goes via peering — any constraints from legal/compliance?

miriam_cs: Legal ok for now, they signed data-processing addendum. Peering not required — just allowlist and region. Please include the following snippet for the infra ticket:

```
org_id: solsticeai-prod
region: eu-west-3
temp_rate: { qps: 150, burst: 400, duration_hours: 72 }
ip_allowlist: ["34.89.12.5/32","34.89.12.6/32"]
auto_revoke: true
fallback_model: redwood-small-v1
alert_if_latency_ms: 400
```

ton y_infra: Thanks — filing now.

deploy-bot: Configuration job #cfg-86723 queued by tony_infra. Estimated completion ~10m. :gear:

ton y_infra: Done — eu-west-3 edge provisioned, temp rate policy applied, IPs added. Auto-revoke scheduled for 2026-03-26 14:00 UTC. Please confirm with SolsticeAI and mark as green if pilot looks good.

miriam_cs: Pinged the customer with start time and rollback criteria. Will capture post-pilot feedback in the renewal notes. :thumbsup: 

ellie_ops: Marking this in the onboarding tracker: ONB-412 (eu-west-3 pilot, temp burst). I'll also note renewal risk low if pilot converts.

miriam_cs: Great — closing loop here. If any error appears, tag me and asif. Thanks everyone! :sparkles:
